_comment: UNSPSC CLASS (6-digit) scope map for the SECOP pre-filter (dir_1784416887835). SECOP tags every process with an 8-digit commodity code (secop_licitaciones.unspsc_code, e.g. 81102200); the 6-digit CLASS is its first 6 digits. Filtering at the 4-digit FAMILY was too coarse — family 8110 mixes class 811015 (civil engineering, 46 open tenders = biggest noise) with 811115 (software engineering). We gate at the class level instead. relevant=true = Skyline's lane, decided by King Kazuma 2026-07-18: SERVICES + SOFTWARE + CYBERSECURITY + CONNECTIVITY + NETWORK/DATACENTER GEAR (switches, APs, storage/NAS, servers). OUT: commodity PC/printer supply, civil/electrical/railway engineering, management/logistics/events (segment 80 entirely). Classes NOT listed here are treated as NOT relevant (excluded by default — safe). `label` is a descriptive Spanish name grounded in `example` (a real tender title from our DB — the authoritative anchor). Edit `relevant` to tune, then restart the bridge to reseed. Marginal calls defaulted to false and worth revisiting: 811516 (GIS), 811120 (digitalización de documentos), 431915 (radios).
